text:
Ava Kim: Hey everyone - accepted the GitHub org invite but when I try to list repos with `gh repo list redwood-inference` I get 0 repos. Web shows me as a member though. Any pointers?

Riley (DevEx): Welcome Ava! Two quick checks: 1) Do you see any teams on your org profile page? 2) Did you authorize SSO after signing in?

Ava Kim: I only see 'Member' and no teams. I clicked the blue 'Authorize SSO' button after accepting.

Marta (IT): Sometimes the issue is an old personal PAT cached in the GH CLI or local git credential helper. Run `gh auth status` and `git credential-osxkeychain erase` (or the equivalent on Windows) to clear.

Ava Kim: `gh auth status` shows my work account (ava@redwood.ai). I did have a lingering PAT set in the OS keychain for my personal account. Removed it and re-logged in.

Leo (Security): FYI our org blocks PATs that aren't org-authorized for some admin actions; that can surface as missing repos if the token lacks org:read. Good that you removed the old PAT.

Ava Kim: After logging in again, I still don't see team repos. The org page shows me as member with SSO authorized. Could the team provisioning be delayed?

Riley (DevEx): Could be SCIM provisioning delay, but first check if there's a repo-specific invite. Some repos are set to 'Restricted' and only visible to specific teams. What repo are you missing?

Ava Kim: `redwood-inference/client-sdk` - it's part of the 'client-eng' team I was told I'd be in.

Marta (IT): I see your account in the org but not in the `client-eng` team. Our SCIM sync shows a failure for users created yesterday due to a token rotation. I can manually add you to the team now.

DevEx Bot: Onboarding checklist: GitHub invite accepted (membership present) - pending team assignment.

Ava Kim: Manual add please, would love to get the SDK running.

Marta (IT): Added you to `client-eng` and granted repo access. Try `gh repo view redwood-inference/client-sdk` now.

Ava Kim: Repo visible! Cloned and ran `make test` locally. Thanks.

Leo (Security): Quick reminder: ensure 2FA is enabled and your SSH key is added to your work account (https://github.com/settings/keys). Org policy requires 2FA for all members.

Ava Kim: 2FA on and SSH key added. `ssh -T git@github.com` returns "Hi ava! You've successfully authenticated."

Riley (DevEx): Great. We'll follow up with IT to fix the SCIM sync so future hires don't need manual adds. Logged a ticket in infra-iam.

Ava Kim: Thanks team — super quick turnaround. :tada: If anything else pops up I'll ping here.
